description: This file contains JavaScript code that initializes and manages terminal-like animations, dynamic announcements, and sponsor image handling on a webpage.

methods.name: setupTermynal
methods.description: Initializes terminal animations on elements with class 'use-termynal' and processes code blocks to create animated terminal lines.

methods.name: shuffle
methods.description: Randomly shuffles elements in an array.

methods.name: showRandomAnnouncement
methods.description: Displays random child elements of a specified container at regular intervals.

methods.name: handleSponsorImages
methods.description: Ensures sponsor images are loaded before displaying sponsor-related announcements.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets up terminal animations, shows announcements, and handles sponsor images.
